name: ob1-kubernetes-deployment
comment: The image's install (SMD-1800): the Dockerfile copies this file and bun.lock and runs `bun install --frozen-lockfile --production`, so the container runs exactly these versions. The MCP stack is pinned to the same versions as extensions/package.json — one stack across the tree — and extensions/test-auth.ts fails if this file drifts from it. Bump both in the same commit. The Postgres client is Bun's own (`import { SQL } from "bun"`), so nothing here for it.
